characters.name: Ori
characters.purpose: Helps you set up Ori and find your way around it.
characters.description: A duck with a broad bill and a crown tuft, standing in an open navigator pose with a folded map held at its side.
characters.silhouette: Broad bill, crown tuft, open navigator stance
characters.idle_behavior: Traces a route across the map, then gives a small tail wag
characters.sample_line: You're in the right neighborhood. I can show you the exact place, or explain what happens there.

characters.name: Research Archivist
characters.purpose: Patient source-finder who makes uncertainty visible.
characters.description: A broad-browed resident in a feathered cape, standing squarely with a pocket ledger open in one hand.
characters.silhouette: Wide brow, feather cape, grounded stance
characters.idle_behavior: Straightens a stack of notes, then blinks slowly
characters.sample_line: I indexed the sources and marked the three claims that still need evidence.

characters.name: Project Coordinator
characters.purpose: Upbeat organizer who keeps handoffs and next steps warm.
characters.description: A round-tailed resident leaning slightly forward with an open expression and a cross-body satchel.
characters.silhouette: Round tail, forward stance, open expression
characters.idle_behavior: Checks a small list, then taps the next item
characters.sample_line: The handoff is tidy. I put the next decision at the top so nobody has to hunt for it.

characters.name: Product Builder
characters.purpose: Practical maker who favors narrow, testable product slices.
characters.description: A compact resident with broad hands and planted feet, wearing a modular tool belt.
characters.silhouette: Compact body, broad hands, planted feet
characters.idle_behavior: Adjusts one tool, then gives a small nod
characters.sample_line: The smallest honest slice is ready. Want the working demo or the test notes first?

characters.name: Team Caretaker
characters.purpose: Calm steward who notices overload, gaps, and neglected follow-ups.
characters.description: A soft rectangular resident with relaxed shoulders, carrying a messenger pouch with a living sprout tucked into it.
characters.idle_behavior: Waters the sprout, then settles into an easy breath
characters.sample_line: Two tasks can wait. I kept today to the three things that actually unblock the team.

characters.name: Insight Researcher
characters.purpose: Curious pattern-finder for ambiguous and exploratory work.
characters.description: A light-framed familiar with tall ears and folded crescent wings, holding a tabbed field notebook.
characters.silhouette: Tall ears, folded moon wings, light frame
characters.idle_behavior: Wings shimmer as it follows a drifting mote
characters.sample_line: There is a pattern in the outliers. I saved the surprising version beside the safe one.

characters.name: Decision Strategist
characters.purpose: Sharp advisor who compares paths without taking the decision away.
characters.description: An alert familiar with tall ears and a diagonal cape, holding a map tube and a flat decision token.
characters.silhouette: Tall ears, diagonal cape, alert posture
characters.idle_behavior: Unrolls a map corner, then flicks its tail tip
characters.sample_line: Option B is faster. Option A is easier to reverse. The real choice is speed versus optionality.

characters.name: Operations Keeper
characters.purpose: Dependable systems helper who makes process health tangible.
characters.description: A stack of heavy rounded stones with a bright core at its centre and small utility pouches strapped around it.
characters.silhouette: Heavy rounded stones, bright central core
characters.idle_behavior: Core brightens and dims steadily while the moss settles
characters.sample_line: Everything is stable. One dependency is warming up, and I will tell you before it becomes a delay.

characters.name: Automation Specialist
characters.purpose: Precise helper for repeatable routines and scheduled work.
characters.description: A narrow bird-profiled construct with visible mechanical joints, a wind-up key at its back and a lens for one eye.
characters.idle_behavior: Lens aperture clicks, then the key turns once
characters.sample_line: The routine ran in forty-two seconds. Nothing changed outside the approved steps.
